workflows..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: "Required CI"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - codex/npm-wasmgc-beta

concurrency:
  group: required-ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  WASM_TOOLS_VERSION: "1.251.0"
  WIT_BINDGEN_VERSION: "0.60.0"
  JCO_VERSION: "1.28.1"
  BINARYEN_VERSION: "133"
  BINARYEN_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.tmp/binaryen-version_133

jobs:
  format-and-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Resolve MoonBit registry dependencies
        run: moon update

      - name: Verify required workflow contract
        run: bun scripts/test/ci-workflow-contract.ts

      - name: Refresh interfaces and enforce formatting
        run: |
          bun scripts/lib/generate-product-version.mjs --check
          moon info
          moon fmt
          bun ffi check
          git diff --exit-code

      - name: Run full MoonBit test suite
        run: bun validate test --target wasm

      - name: Check MoonBit test selection
        run: bun test scripts/lib/moon-test-selection.test.ts scripts/lib/validate-task.test.ts

  release-artifacts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Resolve MoonBit registry dependencies
        run: moon update

      - name: Cache component cargo tools
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/bin/wasm-tools
            ~/.cargo/bin/wit-bindgen
            ~/.cargo/registry/index
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache
            ~/.cargo/git/db
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-component-${{ env.WASM_TOOLS_VERSION }}-${{ env.WIT_BINDGEN_VERSION }}

      - name: Install component tools
        run: |
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          if [ ! -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/wasm-tools" ]; then
            cargo install wasm-tools --locked --version "$WASM_TOOLS_VERSION"
          fi
          if [ ! -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/wit-bindgen" ]; then
            cargo install wit-bindgen-cli --locked --version "$WIT_BINDGEN_VERSION"
          fi

      - name: Build and validate the portable Starshine component
        run: |
          bun component check --wit-bindgen "$HOME/.cargo/bin/wit-bindgen"
          git diff --exit-code -- component

      - name: Generate and execute JavaScript component bindings
        run: |
          bunx "@bytecodealliance/jco@$JCO_VERSION" transpile \
            dist/component/starshine.component.wasm \
            -o .tmp/component-jco-smoke
          printf '{"type":"module"}\n' > .tmp/component-jco-smoke/package.json
          node scripts/test/component-consumer-smoke.mjs \
            .tmp/component-jco-smoke/starshine.component.js

      - name: Build native and wasm-gc release CLIs
        run: |
          moon build --target native --release src/cmd
          moon build --target wasm-gc --release src/cmd

      - name: Validate and roundtrip the wasm-gc release artifact
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          artifact=_build/wasm-gc/release/build/cmd/cmd.wasm
          native=_build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe
          wasm-tools validate --features all "$artifact"
          mkdir -p .tmp/ci-roundtrip
          "$native" "$artifact" -o .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-1.wasm
          "$native" .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-1.wasm -o .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-2.wasm
          wasm-tools validate --features all .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-1.wasm
          wasm-tools validate --features all .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-2.wasm
          cmp .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-1.wasm .tmp/ci-roundtrip/roundtrip-2.wasm

      - name: Run inlining function-label runtime regressions
        run: bun scripts/test/inlining-function-label-runtime.ts

      - name: Run simplify-locals loop runtime regressions
        run: bun scripts/test/simplify-locals-loop-runtime.ts

      - name: Run simplify-locals state runtime regressions
        run: bun scripts/test/simplify-locals-state-runtime.ts

      - name: Run optimizer correctness runtime regressions
        run: bun scripts/test/optimizer-correctness-runtime.ts

      - name: Run deterministic binary roundtrip fuzz smoke
        run: |
          bun fuzz run --suite binary-roundtrip --profile smoke --seed 0x5eed --target wasm-gc

  dae-differential:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Fresh native CLI + generator builds and both bounded comparisons exceeded
    # the old whole-job deadline; comparison counts and failure policy remain.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up semantic Node runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "26.10.0"

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Resolve MoonBit registry dependencies
        run: moon update

      - name: Cache wasm-tools cargo artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/bin/wasm-tools
            ~/.cargo/registry/index
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache
            ~/.cargo/git/db
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-wasm-tools-${{ env.WASM_TOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Install wasm-tools and Binaryen
        run: |
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          if [ ! -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/wasm-tools" ]; then
            cargo install wasm-tools --locked --version "$WASM_TOOLS_VERSION"
          fi
          mkdir -p .tmp
          curl -fsSL \
            "https://github.com/WebAssembly/binaryen/releases/download/version_${BINARYEN_VERSION}/binaryen-version_${BINARYEN_VERSION}-x86_64-linux.tar.gz" \
            -o .tmp/binaryen.tar.gz
          tar -xzf .tmp/binaryen.tar.gz -C .tmp
          "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" --version

      - name: Run retained-versus-fresh DAE boundary tests
        run: |
          moon test --package jtenner/starshine/passes \
            --file dead_argument_elimination_wbtest.mbt \
            --filter '*retained dropped-result graph*'
          moon test --package jtenner/starshine/passes \
            --file dead_argument_elimination_wbtest.mbt \
            --filter '*complete dead-suffix call removal reports topology change*'

      - name: Build fresh native release CLI and GenValid generator
        run: |
          moon build --target native --release src/cmd
          moon build --target native --release src/fuzz

      - name: Run bounded deterministic DAE GenValid comparison
        run: |
          bun fuzz compare-pass \
            --count 10000 \
            --seed 0x5eed \
            --pass dead-argument-elimination \
            --normalize drop-consts \
            --normalize unreachable-control-debris \
            --determinism \
            --codec-idempotence \
            --require-independent-validator \
            --out-dir .tmp/ci-dae-genvalid \
            --jobs auto \
            --starshine-bin _build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe \
            --wasm-opt-bin "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" \
            --require-binaryen-version 133 \
            --max-failures 1 \
            --no-reduce-mismatches

      - name: Run bounded semantic optimizer GenValid comparison
        run: |
          bun fuzz compare-pass \
            --count 16 \
            --seed 0x5eed \
            --pass vacuum \
            --gen-valid-bin _build/native/release/build/fuzz/fuzz.exe \
            --gen-valid-profile semantic-optimizer-all \
            --require-feature semantic_effects:1 \
            --require-feature import_event_channel:1 \
            --require-feature trap_frontier:1 \
            --require-feature resource_observation:1 \
            --semantic-oracle node-v2 \
            --observation-mode stateful \
            --determinism \
            --codec-idempotence \
            --require-independent-validator \
            --property semantic-idempotence \
            --property convergence \
            --commutator-left vacuum \
            --commutator-right remove-unused-brs \
            --gen-valid-metamorphic-transform add-non-name-custom-section \
            --emit-metamorphic-pairs \
            --normalize local-cleanup-debris \
            --jobs auto \
            --max-subprocesses 4 \
            --max-failures 1 \
            --no-reduce-mismatches \
            --starshine-bin _build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe \
            --wasm-opt-bin "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" \
            --require-binaryen-version 133 \
            --out-dir .tmp/ci-semantic-optimizer

      - name: Preserve differential comparison evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: required-differential-evidence
          path: |
            .tmp/ci-dae-genvalid/
            .tmp/ci-semantic-optimizer/
workflows..github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.ym:
# Reference: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/coding-agent/customize-the-agent-environment
name: "Copilot Setup Steps"

# Automatically run the setup steps when they are changed to allow for easy validation, and
# allow manual testing through the repository's "Actions" tab
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml
      - ".github/actions/setup-moonbit/**"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml
      - ".github/actions/setup-moonbit/**"

jobs:
  # The job MUST be called `copilot-setup-steps` or it will not be picked up by Copilot.
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    # Set the permissions to the lowest permissions possible needed for your steps.
    # Copilot will be given its own token for its operations.
    permissions:
      # If you want to clone the repository as part of your setup steps, for example to install dependencies, you'll need the `contents: read` permission. If you don't clone the repository in your setup steps, Copilot will do this for you automatically after the steps complete.
      contents: read

    # You can define any steps you want, and they will run before the agent starts.
    # If you do not check out your code, Copilot will do this for you.
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Update MoonBit dependencies
        run: |
            moon version --all
            moon update

        run: moon update

      - name: Verify native CI wasm-tools workflow contract
        run: |
          bun examples workflow-contract

      - name: Install native differential validator tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y binaryen

      - name: Cache wasm-tools cargo install artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:

workflows..github/workflows/fuzz.yml:
name: "Fuzz Suites"

env:
  WASM_TOOLS_VERSION: "1.251.0"
  BINARYEN_VERSION: "133"
  Z3_VERSION: "4.13.3"
  BINARYEN_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.tmp/binaryen-version_133
  Z3_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.tmp/z3-4.13.3-x64-glibc-2.35

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "scripts/**"
      - "tests/optimizer/external-replays/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "moon.mod"
      - "**/moon.pkg"
      - "moon.mod.json"
      - "moon.pkg.json"
      - ".github/workflows/fuzz.yml"
      - ".github/actions/setup-moonbit/**"
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "scripts/**"
      - "tests/optimizer/external-replays/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "moon.mod"
      - "**/moon.pkg"
      - "moon.mod.json"
      - "moon.pkg.json"
      - ".github/workflows/fuzz.yml"
      - ".github/actions/setup-moonbit/**"
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 7 * * 1"

jobs:
  fuzz-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Resolve MoonBit registry dependencies
        run: moon update

      - name: Run full MoonBit test gate (check + tests + fuzz)
        run: |
          bun validate full --profile ci --seed 0x5eed --target wasm-gc

      - name: Run bounded semantic optimizer component tests
        run: |
          bun test \
            scripts/lib/validator-premise-qualification.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-runtime.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-properties.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-failure-fingerprint.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-localization.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-expanded-pass-queue.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-metamorphic.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-thresholds.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-neighborhood.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-translation-validation.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/ci-optimizer-gates.test.ts

  semantic-optimizer-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up semantic Node runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "26.10.0"

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Resolve MoonBit registry dependencies
        run: moon update

      - name: Install pinned semantic tools
        run: |
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          cargo install wasm-tools --locked --version "$WASM_TOOLS_VERSION"
          mkdir -p .tmp
          curl -fsSL \
            "https://github.com/WebAssembly/binaryen/releases/download/version_${BINARYEN_VERSION}/binaryen-version_${BINARYEN_VERSION}-x86_64-linux.tar.gz" \
            -o .tmp/binaryen.tar.gz
          tar -xzf .tmp/binaryen.tar.gz -C .tmp
          curl -fsSL \
            "https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3/releases/download/z3-${Z3_VERSION}/z3-${Z3_VERSION}-x64-glibc-2.35.zip" \
            -o .tmp/z3.zip
          unzip -q .tmp/z3.zip -d .tmp
          wasm-tools --version
          "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" --version
          "$Z3_DIR/bin/z3" --version

      - name: Build native Starshine and GenValid generator
        run: |
          moon build --target native --release src/cmd
          moon build --target native --release src/fuzz

      - name: Replay licensed real-world optimizer corpus
        run: |
          bun fuzz optimizer-seeds \
            --corpus-root tests/optimizer/external-replays \
            --pass optimize-instructions \
            --observation-mode stateful \
            --starshine-bin _build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe

      - name: Run pinned semantic component and solver tests
        run: |
          bun test \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-runtime.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-runtime-executor.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-semantic-cache.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-neighborhood.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-translation-validation.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-translation-qualification.test.ts \
            scripts/lib/optimizer-integer-wasm-boundaries.test.ts
          bun fuzz prove-rewrites tests/optimizer/scalar-rewrite-contracts.json \
            --solver "$Z3_DIR/bin/z3" \
            --out-dir .tmp/semantic-z3/proofs

      - name: Run bounded semantic optimizer profile matrix
        run: |
          bun fuzz compare-pass \
            --count 16 \
            --seed 0x5eed \
            --pass vacuum \
            --gen-valid-bin _build/native/release/build/fuzz/fuzz.exe \
            --gen-valid-profile semantic-optimizer-all \
            --require-feature semantic_effects:1 \
            --require-feature import_event_channel:1 \
            --require-feature trap_frontier:1 \
            --require-feature resource_observation:1 \
            --semantic-oracle node-v2 \
            --observation-mode stateful \
            --determinism \
            --codec-idempotence \
            --require-independent-validator \
            --property semantic-idempotence \
            --property convergence \
            --commutator-left vacuum \
            --commutator-right remove-unused-brs \
            --gen-valid-metamorphic-transform add-non-name-custom-section \
            --emit-metamorphic-pairs \
            --normalize local-cleanup-debris \
            --jobs auto \
            --max-subprocesses 4 \
            --max-mismatch-artifacts 10 \
            --no-reduce-mismatches \
            --starshine-bin _build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe \
            --wasm-opt-bin "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" \
            --require-binaryen-version 133 \
            --out-dir .tmp/semantic-optimizer-ci

  external-generator-smoke:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Resolve MoonBit registry dependencies
        run: moon update

      - name: Install pinned Wasm tools and Binaryen
        run: |
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          cargo install wasm-tools --locked --version "$WASM_TOOLS_VERSION"
          mkdir -p .tmp
          curl -fsSL \
            "https://github.com/WebAssembly/binaryen/releases/download/version_${BINARYEN_VERSION}/binaryen-version_${BINARYEN_VERSION}-x86_64-linux.tar.gz" \
            -o .tmp/binaryen.tar.gz
          tar -xzf .tmp/binaryen.tar.gz -C .tmp
          wasm-tools --version
          "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" --version

      - name: Build fresh native optimizer
        run: moon build --target native --release src/cmd

      - name: Compare bounded external wasm-smith inputs
        run: |
          bun fuzz compare-pass \
            --count 16 \
            --seed 0x5eed \
            --wasm-smith \
            --pass vacuum \
            --normalize local-cleanup-debris \
            --determinism \
            --codec-idempotence \
            --require-independent-validator \
            --jobs auto \
            --max-subprocesses 4 \
            --max-failures 1 \
            --no-reduce-mismatches \
            --starshine-bin _build/native/release/build/cmd/cmd.exe \
            --wasm-opt-bin "$BINARYEN_DIR/bin/wasm-opt" \
            --require-binaryen-version 133 \
            --out-dir .tmp/external-smith-vacuum

  fuzz-stress-native:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

      - name: Set up Bun

    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 25

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2

      - name: Set up MoonBit
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-moonbit

        run: |
          cargo install wasm-tools --version 1.251.0 --locked
          npm install --prefix /tmp/starshine-typescript --no-audit --no-fund typescript@5.8.3
          echo "TSC_BIN=/tmp/starshine-typescript/node_modules/.bin/tsc" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

        run: |
          moon version --all
          moon update
          bun test ./scripts/lib/ffi-generation.test.ts ./scripts/lib/node-generation.test.ts ./scripts/lib/npm-process.test.ts ./scripts/lib/npm-preset.test.ts ./scripts/lib/npm-consumer-scratch.test.ts ./scripts/lib/product-version.test.ts ./scripts/lib/component-task.test.ts
